questions.scenario: You are getting an outfit stitched at the local tailor (Darzi) for a cousin's wedding.

options.text: I check the stitching quality, the inner lining, and how perfectly it fits my body.
I make sure the fabric is exactly what Bollywood celebs are currently wearing.
I draw a rough sketch to show the tailor exactly what kind of neck design and embroidery I want.
I aggressively bargain with the tailor for the stitching price and delivery date.

questions.scenario: You have an old pair of jeans that you don't wear anymore.

options.text: I grab scissors, cut them into shorts, and physically distress (tear) them myself.
I read articles on sustainable fashion and decide to donate them.
I buy fabric paint and paint cool customized artwork all over the pockets.
I put them up for sale on an app like Thrift or Instagram to make some quick cash.

questions.scenario: You are watching a grand Manish Malhotra or Sabyasachi fashion show on YouTube.

options.text: I look closely at the heavy embroidery, the draping, and how the garment is held together.
I analyze the overall theme and try to guess what color will be popular next year.
I admire the aesthetic beauty, the silhouettes, and the creative vision of the designer.
I wonder how much profit they make by selling a single lehenga for 5 Lakh rupees.

questions.scenario: You are shopping with your friends at a crowded local market like Sarojini Nagar or Colaba.

options.text: I constantly touch the clothes to check if the fabric is cheap or durable.
I quickly spot the one trendy jacket hidden in a pile of outdated clothes.
I mix and match different random pieces to create a highly unique aesthetic outfit.
I handle the negotiations and bring the price down by 50% for my friends.

questions.scenario: Your school is having a 'Traditional Day' or 'Farewell Party'.

options.text: I spend hours making sure my saree pleats or my blazer fitting is absolutely sharp.
I avoid what everyone else is wearing and try to start a completely new trend.
I carefully curate my entire look—matching shoes, jewelry, hair, and outfit perfectly.
I help my friends rent outfits cheaply from a good store I know.

questions.scenario: When you open your wardrobe in the morning, what is your struggle?

options.text: Nothing ever fits perfectly; I always need to use a belt or roll up the sleeves.
I feel like my clothes are so 'last season' and I need a wardrobe upgrade.
I spend 20 minutes trying to color-coordinate my clothes aesthetically.
I realize I spent all my pocket money on clothes but still have 'nothing to wear'.

questions.scenario: You are buying a winter jacket online on Myntra.

options.text: I check the 'Material Care' section to see if it's machine washable or dry clean only.
I filter by 'New Arrivals' to see what the current winter style is.
I zoom into the photos to see the cut, the zipper style, and the overall shape.
I wait for the 'End of Reason Sale' to get the maximum discount possible.

questions.scenario: In your friend group, you are known as the person who...

options.text: Can quickly fix a broken strap or a missing button in an emergency.
Always knows what sneakers or brands are currently cool.
Gives the best styling advice on how to look good for an event.
Knows all the secret places and websites to buy the best clothes cheaply.

questions.scenario: You see a celebrity wearing a very weird, unique outfit at an award show.

options.text: I wonder how heavy that dress is and how the tailor managed to stitch that complex structure.
I realize that within two months, cheap copies of this dress will be everywhere in local markets.
I critique the look—thinking about how I would have designed the sleeves differently.
I think about the massive PR and money the designer made by dressing that celebrity.

questions.scenario: If you started your own clothing brand, what would be your focus?

options.text: Creating the most comfortable, high-quality, long-lasting fabrics and perfect fits.
Creating a fast-fashion brand that immediately catches onto viral internet trends.
Creating highly unique, artistic, and visually stunning signature pieces.
Creating an affordable brand that scales quickly and opens 100 stores across India.

Garment_Constructor.title: Pattern Maker / Garment Technologist
Garment_Constructor.primary_match_text: You are a hands-on perfectionist! You care deeply about the physical reality of clothes—the fit, the fabric, the stitching, and the structure.
Garment_Constructor.day_in_the_life: Working with fabrics, cutting patterns precisely, and ensuring the designer's sketch becomes a wearable, perfectly fitting reality.
Garment_Constructor.alternative_match_text: Because you love creating physical structures, you would also be excellent in Product Design or Quality Control.
Garment_Constructor.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Des in Fashion Technology (B.FTech) from NIFT.

Trend_Forecaster.title: Fashion Researcher / Trend Forecaster
Trend_Forecaster.primary_match_text: You are a visionary observer! You have a sharp eye for culture and you always know what is going to be 'cool' before everyone else does.
Trend_Forecaster.day_in_the_life: Analyzing global fashion weeks, researching youth culture, and predicting the colors and styles that brands should manufacture next year.
Trend_Forecaster.alternative_match_text: Your strong analytical skills and cultural awareness make you a perfect fit for Fashion Journalism or Brand Strategy.
Trend_Forecaster.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th (Arts/Commerce). Pursue a B.Des in Fashion Communication or a BA in Sociology/Culture Studies.

Fashion_Designer.title: Fashion / Apparel Designer
Fashion_Designer.primary_match_text: You are a pure creative soul! You have a beautiful sense of aesthetics, color, and you love expressing yourself through visual styling.
Fashion_Designer.day_in_the_life: Sketching new outfits, selecting color palettes, draping fabrics, and creating stunning collections for runways or retail brands.
Fashion_Designer.alternative_match_text: Your high level of creativity also makes you an excellent candidate for Costume Design in movies or Personal Styling.
Fashion_Designer.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th. Clear NIFT/NID exams and pursue a B.Des in Fashion Design.

Fashion_Merchandiser.title: Fashion Merchandiser / Boutique Owner
Fashion_Merchandiser.primary_match_text: You are a fashion-forward entrepreneur! You love clothes, but you love the business, the deals, and the profit behind the clothes even more.
Fashion_Merchandiser.day_in_the_life: Negotiating with fabric suppliers, deciding the pricing of a new collection, and managing the business operations of a retail fashion brand.
Fashion_Merchandiser.alternative_match_text: With your street-smart business mind, you could easily excel in Retail Management, E-commerce, or running your own startup.
Fashion_Merchandiser.roadmap: Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.FTech, BBA in Retail Management, or a Master of Fashion Management (MFM).
